fieldNotes.truckGate: Single truck entrance is an open driveway off S Cicero Ave at the SW corner of the property. Pavement turn-arrow markings are present but there is no barrier arm, sliding/swing gate, guard booth, or checkpoint pinch-point in z19-z20 satellite (2026) or 2024 Street View. Open driveway = no controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth structure at the entrance in any view.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Main dock bank on the west face fronting a wide truck court; a second dock band on the south face fronts an employee parking lot. ~65 doors estimated - low confidence, band could be 25-50 or 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Truck court is nearly empty in 2026 imagery - facility appears lightly utilized; no marked drop-trailer stalls.
fieldNotes.dropYard: No dedicated trailer-storage lot - the west truck court holds only a few trailers.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Wide deep concrete truck court between the road entrance and the west dock face; ample queuing room for 3+ trucks.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Very wide entrance and an essentially empty truck court leave abundant room to add an express lane.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Primary truck docks on a single (west) face; the south-face dock band fronts employee parking, not a separate active truck cluster.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Site is in Tinley Park, a Chicago southwest-suburb metro area, immediately beside I-80 with residential subdivisions adjacent; judged Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Estimated from perimeter box (~435m x ~375m) covering the building, truck court, and surrounding parking.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; no rail line adjacent (I-80 borders the SE).
fieldNotes.facilityNote: Racklify lists the Tinley Park CJ facility at 305,545 sq ft. The 2026 satellite shows a large, modern but lightly-used building with an empty truck court.
